== Original printed-face source; card data unchanged ==
Added the [https://web.archive.org/web/20080512224256/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/reegesk.html archived original Decipher card page] as an explicitly labeled original printed-face source. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20040810192622im_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/images/reegesk.gif original black-border scan] and current wiki image were visually checked. The original face and current page image say "Once each turn during your control phase" and "search through opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial and take one vehicle, droid, weapon or device into your hand". The current game-text field instead says "Once during each of your control phases" and "take one vehicle, droid, weapon or device from opponent's Lost Pile or Crash Site Memorial into hand". This wording difference remains unresolved and unchanged. Existing secondary sources are retained. No game text, lore, stats, icons, UID, version label, image, printings or sibling page was changed; the citation does not certify the current data as identical to the original face.
